Name: Farm Dog Harry Du Bois
Author: IMatsu4
Description:
[list]
[*]Requires Content Patcher
[*]Harry's [s]dumb [/s]beautiful face should show up in the character customization menu when clicking through Animal Preferences
[*]Option to turn off Harry's thought bubbles in config 
[/list] ﻿ ﻿-Run the game through SMAPI to generate a config.json, then close ﻿
﻿ ﻿-Open new config.json to change "thoughts" value 
﻿ ﻿-Default is "true". To turn off, set to "false"

Optional, but recommended mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32507]Farm Cat Kim Katsuragi[/url]

Manifest.Name: FarmDogHarryDuBois
Manifest.Description: You can now have Harrier Du Bois running wild on your farm. Isn't that something you always wanted?
